description: OpenClassrooms AI and machine-learning course access made available through Sorbonne University's SORBONNE.AI programme.
howToObtain: Register through the SORBONNE.AI/SCAI Education path and receive or use the associated OpenClassrooms course licence.
costToUser: The official programme page describes university-provided licences; it does not state a student charge.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: SORBONNE.AI states that OpenClassrooms gives access to more than 50 online modular courses on AI and machine learning to 5,000 Sorbonne University students and directs students to register for an OpenClassrooms licence.

description: Sorbonne University's SCAI Education platform for online AI courses and assessments.
howToObtain: Register through the SCAI Education platform; the official page exposes a free sign-up path and course catalogue.
costToUser: The platform page advertises free sign-up; specific course or licence terms are not otherwise stated.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Sorbonne University officially provides SCAI Education as an institutional platform: it invites users to enroll in online AI courses, provides access through a live course catalogue and login/sign-up path, and hosts modules for students, researchers and professionals.
